steps.name: Iris' Whereabouts
steps.objective: Go to the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters" and talk to [Ull].

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Since you've come to me, the message must have arrived properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Iris? Where did you take her?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: She looked to be in danger, so I took her somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere safe?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The mages of the Jewel school are containing her rampage in a secure place.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Iris is losing control.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The Demon King, the embodiment of her fear, shook her fragile heart... And that has become troublesome. I never expected the source of darkness to get inside...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I should have dealt with this myself, but so many unnecessary problems have cropped up in Lumen lately... Now that I say it aloud, it's all excuses.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Sigh... To think I'm explaining even this to you. That's how short-handed we are.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So I'd like you to lend a hand. This concerns Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's about Iris...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Good. You catch on quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This task... is it something I can do?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Since Iris trusts you, you might manage it unexpectedly well. Judging by how much that stunted kid and the spirit with the strange way of talking trust you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He means Muwen and Zoe.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Then go. If you can't resolve this, Iris and the others...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will happen?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The worst thing you can imagine. Now, there's no time to stand around. When you're ready, reach toward the passage in front of me.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The kings inside will explain the rest. I'm counting on you.

steps.name: Iris' Inner World
steps.objective: Go to "Old Belos" and talk to [Harmonia].

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: A human has come to a place like this... Are you perhaps the one the goddess spoke of?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I probably am. But by the goddess, do you mean Lady Seres?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: No, I mean Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goddess Iris... I'm still not used to that.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Looking at you again, you must be the one who has endured such a difficult journey for Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, where is this...? It looks just like Belos.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We're inside the goddess's inner world. This is the place she treasures most of all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belos Village...? That makes perfect sense. I have many memories of it too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ull sent me here, but what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard there's something that needs to be resolved inside...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I see. So Ull sent you...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's both difficult and simple. Please help keep this place from collapsing.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You know that everyone has both good and evil within them, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do. Iris's condition right now...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: For someone born a god, that wouldn't pose much of a problem. But our goddess... Lady Iris is different.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Even as a descendant of the Der race created by a god, Lady Iris is still a human who has spent a long time living among humans.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: She carries many feelings, experiences them, and acts upon them...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: One of those emotions seeks to destroy this place within her. It mixed with malice that came from somewhere else and took on a new form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I need to confront those feelings of Iris's, even if they're only part of her?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, exactly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will that really be all right? What right do I have to interfere with Iris's feelings...?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You needn't worry so much about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, Harmonia, then it really will be all right?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, adventurer. Please go to Mir in the [Burning City].

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Help Mir hold back the evil beings pouring into that place.

steps.name: Spirits of a Dying World
steps.objective: Go to the "Burning City" and talk to [Mir].

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I thought I could deliver the message and go back, but the corrupted ones don't even recognize their superior and keep attacking me. If only Ull were here... Huh? This presence... Could it be?!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ah, over here!! Ull, welcome!! Please use your sword aura on the spirits running wild... Huh?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ull was busy, so I came in his place.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: So you're on our side?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I've followed Iris's footsteps all the way from Belos...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, you're that person. Then please help!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. You'll need to explain a little more.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm sorry. If this place collapses, it's all over...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, but...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm sorry. I was being hasty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how can I help here? I can't tell which spirits are allies and which are enemies...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: All the spirits here are corrupted. A corrupted spirit spreads that corruption to other spirits. I feel sorry for them, but Harmonia and Geis have already given their permission...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Will you be all right, Mir? Even if the other spirits disappear...?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: We have no choice. The spirits will understand too. If they serve the world, then surely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you safe from the corruption, Mir?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes. I'm different from ordinary spirits. I'm also a living being...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

steps.name: Stop the Destruction
steps.objective: Go to the "Burning City" and defeat [Destructive Fire Spirits] and [Corrupted Darkness].

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Um, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm glad nothing happened to you. There were more of them attacking than I expected...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was fine. Thank you for worrying.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Still, thank you for doing even better than I'd hoped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you explain the situation?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If we can't stop this, the world inside Iris will be in danger, right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's right. You know this is the goddess's inner world, don't you? This world reflects her present condition.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: The Burning City represents the destruction of civilization itself.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It means her evil emotions could take control of her body.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: If control is completely taken away, the goddess's world will cease to exist. It may gradually spread beyond her inner world and into reality.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It hasn't happened yet, so don't be afraid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I understand.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Do you know that your power is a blessing from the goddess Seres and Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: If you do, please deal with those corrupted spirits coming this way!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Be careful again, all right? There's still so much I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. Please wait here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Honestly...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Are you hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm not. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What a relief!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: As a spirit who serves living things, it's hard for me to watch anyone get hurt.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: By the way, what did you think of the ones you just fought?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They seemed different from the spirits here. I don't think they were spirits at all. They felt strangely unpleasant. Perhaps because their malice was so strong...?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You noticed correctly. They're the wicked servants of Evil Order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Evil Order...?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Evil Order is a being born from the goddess's malice...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You could say it's a being made entirely of negative feelings toward this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's dark, negative feelings took a form like that...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes... probably...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You and Lady Iris are going through so much...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Even if the path to saving her is long and hard, please keep going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I defeat Iris in those two forms, will Iris herself be all right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: For the time being, she should be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try. I can do this...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, I believe in you. The goddess believes in you too...

steps.name: Another World
steps.objective: Go to the "Burning City" and talk to [Geis].

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: So you are the goddess's helper... I never expected to meet you in person.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It feels almost as though I were meeting Ull.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're comparing me to Ull, I assume you mean that as a compliment?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Spirits bear no malice, unless they have been corrupted. I could sense your aura simply because I am a Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Spirit King? Ah, so you're a spirit. The other spirits are in a strange state, but you seem all right.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes, I am. The power the goddess gave me to care for the children is keeping me alive instead... I can only apologize to them and to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't feel so guilty.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I'm glad you've come. I was barely holding back the children corrupted by the source of darkness and the beings of malice...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia and Mir... They too must be barely holding on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand about Harmonia, but is Mir a Spirit King too?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Not a complete spirit, but a child with power comparable to a Spirit King's.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: In some ways, Mir is more special than we are. Few spirits can move freely between the inner world and the real world...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Perhaps it is precisely because Mir is not entirely a spirit that the child could resist the malice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As a child, Mir survived with a spirit's help and gained a spirit's traits. Mir considers that a blessing.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: No, this is no time for such talk. I wish to place my faith in your strength and ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: With the power, talent, and will I see in you, I believe you can save that world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go to "Chaos Canyon" and defeat the being filled with malice that seeks to destroy this world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The one you seek is there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go, quickly...

steps.name: The First Seed of Evil
steps.objective: Go to the "Chaos Canyon", find [Evil Iris], and defeat her.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: So you are the goddess's helper... I never expected to meet you in person.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It feels almost as though I were meeting Ull.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're comparing me to Ull, I assume you mean that as a compliment?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Spirits bear no malice, unless they have been corrupted. I could sense your aura simply because I am a Spirit King.

lines.text: No, this is no time for such talk. I wish to place my faith in your strength and ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: With the power, talent, and will I see in you, I believe you can save that world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go to "Chaos Canyon" and defeat the being filled with malice that seeks to destroy this world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The one you seek is there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Go, quickly...

steps.name: A Being That Repeats Destruction
steps.objective: Go to the "Frozen World" and defeat [Cynical Iris] and [Evil Order].

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Remarkable. I'd heard of your abilities, but they exceed anything I imagined.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even if it was only a fragment given form from part of the goddess's heart, I never thought you could face it like that.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I didn't know you were so strong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What had you expected?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Since the goddess's awakening was incomplete, I worried that there might be some instability within you as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: After seeing what you've done, I see no reason to worry.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You came all this way for the goddess, and you are someone she trusts. There is no need for further doubt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do now?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: There is something you must do. This time, go to the Frozen World.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Evil Order will be there, seeking to cover everything in malice.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A being that endlessly craves destruction and seeks to repeat it...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Another part of her heart, bearing hatred as great as the goddess's love for this world.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You could call it a trial faced by anyone who ascends to divinity, but the goddess is suffering it with unusual intensity.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: To face a trial before one is ready is terribly cruel...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Even if she overcomes this difficult trial, she will face an even harsher fate.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: But if you help her at her side... I believe she can overcome it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Ah, already gone... Your actions truly show that you are fated to follow the goddess. I leave her in your hands...

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Aha! You really came. What a foolishly forgiving human. You're so entertaining.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What are you thinking, helping that woman when she keeps using you like this? How laughable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I might be funny, but I'm no laughingstock.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's even more laughable is the idea of an evil being like you becoming the God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: A weak Iris, an evil me. Whichever of us becomes the God of the Astral Realm, the world will end up a mess.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: If it's going to be a mess anyway, what's wrong with it being me? So I'd like you to turn back now. ♪

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't leave things like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just can't...

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Hehe, how interesting. You, the being from the place Iris dreams of, are so interesting.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Why do you think you have to help that woman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you think I'm simply helping her, you're mistaken. What I'm doing now isn't only for Iris anymore.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Playing the champion of justice too. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you keep trying to hurt Iris, I won't forgive you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if the feelings inside her changed into something like you, that can't be what she wanted.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I am an evil emotion, a being that grows within it. Don't deny the obvious!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it. I didn't come here to listen to that. So... so!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Get away from Iris now!!

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: It's impressive that you've held your own against me this long. I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many times have you said that already? I've defeated you four times now.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: You say that, but how long can you keep going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine. Let's find out. Let's see how long you can keep saying that.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Very well. I'll face you once more, you foolish human...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll be your opponent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Iris...? Is that you? Oh, Iris's heart? The real Iris is outside.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I was wondering where the weakest part of her heart had gone. So here you are.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Until now, the darkness hid my form and I couldn't do anything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right. Thanks to you, I now have the strength to fight Evil Order. I'll take over, so please stand back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. If that's what you want, Iris, I'll stand back.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Evil Order is part of my heart. That's why it has life force and power close to a god's.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even if you can fight it, you can't destroy it completely. That's why I have to do it, here within my inner world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fight against yourself?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I'll destroy all of you right here... Urgh! What is this power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I sense a barrier of unfamiliar power around Iris and Evil Order.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: W-where are you taking me? It'll still be somewhere inside here!!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You and I are parts of Iris's heart. We'll go somewhere only the heart can reach. Let's settle this there without hurting anyone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The inner world is safe now. Please tell the Spirit Kings. Though this part of me will probably have to fight Evil Order for quite a long time.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And let's meet again in my real body, %s...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (The fragile part of Iris's heart takes hold of Evil Order, and they disappear before my eyes.)

steps.name: Restoring the Inner World
steps.objective: Go to "Old Belos" and talk to [Harmonia].

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Good and evil always struggle within the human heart. A goddess who ascended from humanity will have to face this process time and again.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You have done a great service. Thanks to you, the darkness is gradually receding from the inner world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did feel that things were slowly changing.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. Evil Order has retreated a little, so that must be what you feel. You are truly remarkable.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: What will you do if Evil Order appears in the inner world again?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll fight for Iris.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Yes. That is like you.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The spirits have stopped running wild, so we should be able to deal with the remaining darkness somehow.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As the Spirit King of Obedience and Covenants, I thank you on behalf of the many spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You say you're all right, but something seems to be troubling you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: You're afraid. It's all right. Every human carries fears like these.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for comforting me.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then please tell Harmonia what has happened on your way back. I leave it to you.

steps.name: Complete Divinity
steps.objective: Go to the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters" and talk to [Yuran].

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you. As the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, I thank you once again on behalf of the many spirits.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I can see the children are getting better just by looking at them!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're so grateful, give me something.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I have nothing I can give you right now, but I will grant you the goddess's blessing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's blessing?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hehe. I can't tell you yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a spirit with a lot of secrets.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Just like people, spirits have a secret or two. Sorry, that was a joke. It wasn't very funny, was it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's all right.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The goddess will be all right. She isn't whole yet, but...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If she rests, endures her trials, and overcomes them, she will become a true god.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please help her until then. Everyone says you are someone we can trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I want to believe in her and help her too.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Then let's meet again sometime. If you return to the place where you first arrived, you should be able to go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You've returned from the inner world. Few who enter that place manage to come back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So it was that kind of place. Still, I was all right. Everything ended well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ull looked busy, so I came to ask you about Iris's condition, Yuran.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She's relatively well. Her rampage has stopped, and she's sleeping deeply. Could you tell me what happened in there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I explain to Yuran what happened in Iris's inner world.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm... I've been giving this some thought. My master asked me to consider it as well...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I think Lady Iris's complete awakening will take some time.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: With so many enemies targeting her, and things she still fears, it will take time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Let me explain the conclusions I've reached.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It won't be easy, but...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I've looked into every way we might help Lady Iris become a more steadfast god.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Among them, there is one approach that seems possible...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds as though that will be my job.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Then I'll explain. What we need to do is...
